reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual second-round review of external-02 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 13 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution upper-lip crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

remaining_reasons: The source has one broad dark-brown upper-lip moustache, but the returned native upper-lip crop is completely smooth yellow with no moustache. Restore that source moustache above the single closed mouth while keeping the chin free of beard and preserving the repaired note.
entries.positive_observation: The note retains two upper gray-mark rows, largely blank lower paper and the original small dark right-edge tab. Dark eyebrows remain, with no glasses or added beard. The dark olive-black cap retains gold piping/cord, dense gold visor embroidery and two separated front emblems. The near-frontal pose, single closed mouth, dark olive uniform, gold shoulder accents, red collar patches with pale/gold detailing and one pale-edged dark throat cross remain. The rounded chin meets a short broad collar. The complete dark tilted frame and opaque muted warm grey-olive backing remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The missing broad source moustache is the clear rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine cap-visor and collar embroidery, the tiny throat-cross detail and note lettering are not reliably readable at source scale. These uncertainties are not rejection reasons; the source moustache is visibly present and the returned moustache is visibly absent.
